entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase-like protein
observations: 194-aa query has 46–47% identity and 96–99% coverage to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases; inferred function is Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of dITP, ITP, and XTP to monophosphate plus diphosphate.

Likely contributes to purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism and nucleotide-pool sanitization, limiting incorporation of noncanonical purines into nucleic acids; this is homology-based, not a direct assay of the query.
